title: Sliding Window Extrema
statement:
Use monotonic deques to output both extrema of every length-k window.

Input
n k followed by n signed values.

Output
For each window from left to right, print its minimum and maximum on one line.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. Array values have absolute value at most 10⁹. 1 ≤ k ≤ n.
